properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 22 at 9:33AM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
At 929 AM PDT, Doppler radar was tracking isolated to widely
scattered thunderstorms across a broad portion of Ventura and Los
Angeles Counties. Movement of this activity was northeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph. There is also a small chance for a
brief, weak tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Long Beach...
Thousand Oaks...
Simi Valley...
Eastern Ventura...
Fillmore...
Malibu...
Acton...
Ojai...
Encino...
Inglewood...
Agoura Hills...
Venice...
Hollywood...
Van Nuys...
Alhambra...
Mount Wilson...
Culver City...
Universal City...
Santa Clarita...
and Burbank.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with these storms and may lead
to localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

NWSheadline: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED STRONG THUNDERSTORMS WILL IMPACT VENTURA AND LOS ANGELES COUNTIES THROUGH 1100 AM PDT
